newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TONGAAT-HULETT SEES GROWTH IN CURRENT YEAR.
newsitem.headline: TONGAAT-HULETT SEES GROWTH IN CURRENT YEAR.

text.p: South African sugar to property group Tongaat-Hulett Ltd said on Friday that it expected to post real earnings growth in its current financial year.

"All divisions have forecast real growth in profits for the 1997/98 financial year and this should translate into an increase in real earnings per share at group level," the firm said in a statement with its year results.
